verdict.rationale: Alacritty has its own documented IPC via `alacritty msg`, and its `create-window` subcommand can open new windows programmatically. That covers only a sliver of the story. Alacritty deliberately has no splits or panes, and nothing in the evidence shows the IPC can inject commands into a running terminal or read its output back. missing for 10: pane creation (explicitly out of scope), sending commands into an existing terminal via the protocol, reading terminal output/scrollback programmatically, a documented control-protocol reference, hands-on corroboration of agent use.
